test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: ________ was the first fast bowler who was the Indian test team captain.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kapil Dev.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kapil Dev received two of India's highest civilian honors: the **Padma Shri (1982)** and the** Padma Bhushan (1991).**
 
• In **2002,** he was honored as the **Indian Cricketer of the Century.**
 
• In **2010,** he was inducted into the **International Cricket Council's Hall of Fame.**
 
• Kapil Dev, the legendary Indian cricketer, has authored several autobiographies including:-
 
 
• **"Cricket My Style" **
 
• **"By God's Decree" **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jaspreet Bumrah **was awarded the **Polly Umrigar Award **by the BCCI **twice**, in 2018–19 and 2021–22.

 
 
• He was also named in the **Wisden Cricketers of the Year in 2022.**
 
 
 
• **Zaheer Khan** was honored with the prestigious **“Arjuna Award”** by the Government of India in 2011.
 
 
• He became one of the **"Wisden Cricketers of the Year" in 2008.**
 
 
 
• **Javagal Srinath **is a former Indian cricketer and currently an ICC match referee.
 
 
• With India, Srinath was a member of the Indian team that was the** joint winner of the 2002 ICC Champions Trophy**, a title they shared with Sri Lanka.
 
 
 
• **Anil Kumble** is India's leading **wicket-taker** in Test cricket history across all formats with **953 wickets.**
